description: This file provides a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts deployment status codes into human-readable labels. It replaces underscores/hyphens with spaces, collapses multiple spaces, and converts the text to Title Case, handling apostrophes correctly.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable label with proper formatting, handling null, hyphens, underscores, and apostrophes.
